pageTitle: Our Programmes - Star Kids Nursery & Kindergarten
metaDescription: Explore our early childhood programs at Star Kids: Toddler (1.5 - 2 yrs), PlayGroup (2 - 3 yrs), and Nursery (3 - 4 yrs). Nurturing, safe, stage-based early learning.

hero.title: Our Programmes
hero.subtitle: Holistic early childhood learning pathways designed for every developmental milestone.

sections.title: Designed for Every Developmental Milestone
sections.subtitle: At Star Kids, our stage-by-stage programs provide loving guidance, joyful play, and foundational skills.

cards.title: Low Child-Teacher Ratios
cards.description: Ranging from 1:3 for Toddlers to 1:6 for Nursery, ensuring every child receives attentive care.

cards.title: Play-Based Learning
cards.description: Hands-on sensory bins, imaginative role-play, musical movement, and tactile exploration spark curiosity.

cards.title: Holistic Development
cards.description: Equally nurturing motor agility, language milestones, emotional resilience, and early phonics.

sections.title: Explore Our Learning Stages
sections.subtitle: Carefully sequenced stages from gentle transition toddlers to confident kindergarten scholars.

programs.summary: Our Toddler program is designed as a gentle bridge from home to the wider world. In a soothing, padded environment, toddlers discover sensory textures, practice early gross motor movement, explore expressive sounds, and build secure emotional bonds.
programs.subtitle: First Steps in Joyful Discovery
programs.title: Toddler Programme

programs.summary: PlayGroup is the stage where communication blossoms and peer friendships take root. Children engage in vibrant creative arts, cooperative pretend-play stations, tactile modeling clay, songs, and guided toilet training independence.
programs.subtitle: Imaginative Play & Social Friendship
programs.title: PlayGroup Programme

highlights.details: Parachute games, tricycle relays & soft hurdles

programs.summary: Our Nursery curriculum develops pre-reading phonics, numeracy logic, early scientific observation, and expressive confidence. Children thrive through interactive storytelling circles, hands-on counting labs, gardening, and dramatic theater.
programs.subtitle: STEAM Foundations & Phonics Fun

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subtitle: Common inquiries from parents about enrollment, safety, and schedules.

items.question: What is the enrollment process?
items.answer: We encourage parents to book a guided campus tour. After the tour, you can submit an application form and schedule an observation visit for your child.

items.question: What are the school timings and after-school care options?
items.answer: Standard programs run from 8:30 AM to 12:30 PM (Half Day) or 3:30 PM (Full Day). Extended care is available until 6:00 PM.

items.question: How are meals and allergies handled?
items.answer: We provide fresh organic morning snacks and balanced hot lunches prepared in our dedicated kitchen. All dietary restrictions and allergies are strictly monitored.
